items.source: Additionally you can extend PagingAndSortingRepository, ReactiveSortingRepository, RxJava3SortingRepository, or CoroutineSortingRepository if you need methods that allow to specify a Sort abstraction or in the first case a Pageable abstraction. Note that the various sorting repositories no longer extend their respective CRUD repository as they did in Spring Data versions prior to 3.0. Therefore, you need to extend both interfaces if you want functionality of both.
items.translation: 此外，如果您需要能够指定 Sort 抽象的方法，或者在第一种情况下指定 Pageable 抽象，则可以扩展 PagingAndSortingRepository、ReactiveSortingRepository、RxJava3SortingRepository 或 CoroutineSortingRepository。 请注意，在 Spring Data 3.0 之前的版本中，各种排序存储库曾扩展其各自的 CRUD 存储库，但在当前版本中已不再如此。因此，如果您需要同时具备两者的功能，则需要同时扩展这两个接口。

items.source: In the prior example, you defined a common base interface for all your domain repositories and exposed findById(…) as well as save(…).These methods are routed into the base repository implementation of the store of your choice provided by Spring Data (for example, if you use JPA, the implementation is SimpleJpaRepository), because they match the method signatures in CrudRepository. So the UserRepository can now save users, find individual users by ID, and trigger a query to find Users by email address.
items.translation: 在之前的示例中，您为所有领域仓库定义了一个公共基接口，并暴露了 `findById(…)` 和 `save(…)` 方法。这些方法会被路由到您所选的 Spring Data 存储的基础仓库实现中（例如，如果您使用 JPA，实现类就是 `SimpleJpaRepository`），因为它们与 `CrudRepository` 中的方法签名相匹配。因此，`UserRepository` 现在可以保存用户、通过 ID 查找单个用户，并触发查询以根据电子邮件地址查找 `Users`。

items.source: PersonRepository references Person, which is annotated with the JPA @Entity annotation, so this repository clearly belongs to Spring Data JPA. UserRepository references User, which is annotated with Spring Data MongoDB’s @Document annotation.
items.translation: `PersonRepository` 引用了带有 JPA `@Entity` 注解的 `Person`，因此该仓库显然属于 Spring Data JPA。而 `UserRepository` 引用了带有 Spring Data MongoDB 的 `@Document` 注解的 `User`。

items.source: The typical approach is to extend CrudRepository, which gives you methods for CRUD functionality. CRUD stands for Create, Read, Update, Delete. With version 3.0 we also introduced ListCrudRepository which is very similar to the CrudRepository but for those methods that return multiple entities it returns a List instead of an Iterable which you might find easier to use.
items.translation: 典型的做法是扩展CrudRepository，它提供了 CRUD 功能的方法。CRUD 代表创建（Create）、读取（Read）、更新（Update）和删除（Delete）。 在版本 3.0 中，我们还引入了ListCrudRepository，它与CrudRepository非常相似，但对于返回多个实体的方法，它返回一个List而不是Iterable，这可能更易于使用。

items.source: If you do not want to extend Spring Data interfaces, you can also annotate your repository interface with @RepositoryDefinition. Extending one of the CRUD repository interfaces exposes a complete set of methods to manipulate your entities. If you prefer to be selective about the methods being exposed, copy the methods you want to expose from the CRUD repository into your domain repository. When doing so, you may change the return type of methods. Spring Data will honor the return type if possible. For example, for methods returning multiple entities you may choose Iterable<T>, List<T>, Collection<T> or a VAVR list.
items.translation: 如果您不想扩展 Spring Data 接口，也可以将您的存储库接口标注为@RepositoryDefinition。 继承 CRUD 存储库接口之一会暴露一套完整的用于操作实体的方法。 如果您希望更灵活地选择要暴露的方法，可以将 CRUD 存储库中的所需方法复制到您的领域存储库中。 在此过程中，您可以更改方法的返回类型。 Spring Data 会在可能的情况下尊重您指定的返回类型。 例如，对于返回多个实体的方法，您可以选择Iterable<T>、List<T>、Collection<T>或 VAVR 列表作为返回类型。

items.source: AmbiguousRepository and AmbiguousUserRepository extend only Repository and CrudRepository in their type hierarchy. While this is fine when using a unique Spring Data module, multiple modules cannot distinguish to which particular Spring Data these repositories should be bound.
items.translation: `AmbiguousRepository` 和 `AmbiguousUserRepository` 在其类型层次结构中仅继承自 `Repository` 和 `CrudRepository`。虽然在使用唯一的 Spring Data 模块时这没有问题，但在涉及多个模块时，无法区分这些仓库应绑定到哪一个特定的 Spring Data 实现。

items.source: To define a repository interface, you first need to define a domain class-specific repository interface. The interface must extend Repository and be typed to the domain class and an ID type. If you want to expose CRUD methods for that domain type, you may extend CrudRepository, or one of its variants instead of Repository.
items.translation:
要定义仓储接口，首先需要定义一个针对特定领域类的仓储接口。  
该接口必须扩展 `<code>Repository`》，并指定为领域类和 ID 类型。  
如果希望为该领域类型暴露 CRUD 方法，可以扩展 `<code>CrudRepository`》或其变体，而不是直接扩展 `<code>Repository`》。

items.source: If the domain class is annotated with the module-specific type annotation, it is a valid candidate for the particular Spring Data module. Spring Data modules accept either third-party annotations (such as JPA’s @Entity) or provide their own annotations (such as @Document for Spring Data MongoDB and Spring Data Elasticsearch).
items.translation: 如果领域类使用了模块特定的类型注解进行标注，则该领域类是特定 Spring Data 模块的有效候选者。Spring Data 模块可以接受第三方注解（例如 JPA 的@Entity），也可以提供自己的注解（例如 Spring Data MongoDB 和 Spring Data Elasticsearch 中的@Document）。

items.source: MyRepository and UserRepository extend JpaRepository in their type hierarchy. They are valid candidates for the Spring Data JPA module.
items.translation:
`MyRepository` 和 `UserRepository` 在其类型层次结构中扩展了 `JpaRepository`。  
它们是 Spring Data JPA 模块的有效候选者。

items.source: If you are using a reactive store you might choose ReactiveCrudRepository, or RxJava3CrudRepository depending on which reactive framework you are using.
items.translation: 如果您使用的是响应式存储，可以根据所使用的响应式框架选择ReactiveCrudRepository或。

items.source: This example shows a domain class using both JPA and Spring Data MongoDB annotations. It defines two repositories, JpaPersonRepository and MongoDBPersonRepository. One is intended for JPA and the other for MongoDB usage. Spring Data is no longer able to tell the repositories apart, which leads to undefined behavior.
items.translation: 本示例展示了一个同时使用 JPA 和 Spring Data MongoDB 注解的领域类。 它定义了两个仓库：JpaPersonRepository 和 MongoDBPersonRepository。 其中一个用于 JPA，另一个用于 MongoDB。 Spring Data 已无法区分这两个仓库，从而导致未定义的行为。

items.source: Repository type details and distinguishing domain class annotations are used for strict repository configuration to identify repository candidates for a particular Spring Data module. Using multiple persistence technology-specific annotations on the same domain type is possible and enables reuse of domain types across multiple persistence technologies. However, Spring Data can then no longer determine a unique module with which to bind the repository.
items.translation: 存储库类型详情 和 区分领域类注解 用于严格的存储库配置，以识别特定 Spring Data 模块的存储库候选项。 在同一领域类型上使用多个持久化技术特定的注解是可行的，这使得领域类型能够在多种持久化技术之间复用。 然而，Spring Data 将无法确定一个唯一的模块来绑定该存储库。

items.source: If you are using Kotlin you might pick CoroutineCrudRepository which utilizes Kotlin’s coroutines.
items.translation: 如果您使用的是 Kotlin，可以选择利用 Kotlin 协程的CoroutineCrudRepository。

items.source: If many repositories in your application should have the same set of methods you can define your own base interface to inherit from. Such an interface must be annotated with @NoRepositoryBean. This prevents Spring Data to try to create an instance of it directly and failing because it can’t determine the entity for that repository, since it still contains a generic type variable.
items.translation: 如果您的应用程序中的多个仓库需要拥有相同的一组方法，您可以定义自己的基础接口供其继承。 此类接口必须使用 @NoRepositoryBean 注解进行标记。这样可以防止 Spring Data 尝试直接创建该接口的实例并因无法确定该仓库对应的实体而失败，因为此时它仍然包含泛型类型变量。

items.source: If the repository definition extends the module-specific repository, it is a valid candidate for the particular Spring Data module.
items.translation: 如果仓库定义扩展了特定模块的仓库，则该仓库是相应 Spring Data 模块的有效候选项。

items.source: The last way to distinguish repositories is by scoping repository base packages. Base packages define the starting points for scanning for repository interface definitions, which implies having repository definitions located in the appropriate packages. By default, annotation-driven configuration uses the package of the configuration class. The base package in XML-based configuration is mandatory.
items.translation: 区分仓库的另一种方式是通过限定仓库基础包的范围。基础包定义了扫描仓库接口定义的起点，这意味着仓库定义必须位于相应的包中。默认情况下，注解驱动的配置文件使用配置类所在的包。而在基于 XML 的配置中，基础包是必需的。

items.source: There are a few ways to get started with your repository interface.
items.translation: 有几种方法可以开始使用您的仓库界面。

items.source:
Using a unique Spring Data module in your application makes things simple, because all repository interfaces in the defined scope are bound to the Spring Data module.
Sometimes, applications require using more than one Spring Data module.
In such cases, a repository definition must distinguish between persistence technologies.
When it detects multiple repository factories on the class path, Spring Data enters strict repository configuration mode.
Strict configuration uses details on the repository or the domain class to decide about Spring Data module binding for a repository definition:
items.translation:
在应用程序中使用独特的 Spring Data 模块可以简化操作，因为定义作用域内的所有存储库接口都会绑定到该 Spring Data 模块。  
有时，应用程序需要使用多个 Spring Data 模块。  
在这种情况下，存储库定义必须能够区分不同的持久化技术。  
当检测到类路径中存在多个存储库工厂时，Spring Data 会进入严格的存储库配置模式。  
严格配置会根据存储库或领域类的详细信息来决定为存储库定义绑定哪个 Spring Data 模块：
